en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Saeed Bin Yasaar who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who fell upon a slave girl of his who used to go and come, and he had isolated himself from her and there did not happen to be anything from him to her. What are you<sup>asws</sup> saying regarding the child?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> view that he should not sell this (child), O Saeed!’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Is he accusing her?’ So I said, ‘As for the apparent accusation, so no’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So, is his family accusing her?’ So I said, ‘As for something apparent, so no’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So how can he have the leeway that the child would not be necessitated on him?’
